premises: Multiple B-site cations in high-entropy perovskite oxides (HEO) lead to synergistic redox interactions.
These redox interactions modulate the d-band center positions.
Modulated d-band centers optimize adsorption energies for OER intermediates.
Optimized adsorption energies substantially enhance OER catalytic activity and durability.
The HEO LaCr0.2Mn0.2Fe0.2Co0.2Ni0.2O3–δ outperforms single B-site perovskites by 17–680× in current density.
